title: LibraryMeta
description: An add's meta (contract §2.8): the JSON whose base64 is the X-Midstudy-Meta header of POST /api/library/items. Anything wrong is 400 with one actionable sentence.

id.description: Default: a slug of name. Re-adding an id replaces it (upsert).

mount.description: v1 also takes null (the default, floor).

yaw.description: Degrees, around Y after the engine's default orientation (§3.1).

engine.description: Images: idol (default), sam3d, trellis2 or rug. Models: glb (the only one; anything else is 400).
